software_class: document ingestion, extraction, classification, and review workflow

options.name: Rules and OCR pipeline
options.when_to_use: Documents have predictable structure and explainability matters.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when layouts vary heavily or language reasoning dominates.
options.risks: Rules can become brittle across formats.

options.name: Model-assisted extraction
options.when_to_use: Fields require language understanding or layout variation handling.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when deterministic parsing is enough.
options.rationale: Handles varied documents with richer context.
options.risks: Model drift can affect extraction quality.

options.name: Human review workbench
options.when_to_use: Accuracy, corrections, and auditability are central.
options.rationale: Creates quality feedback and audit trail.
options.tradeoffs: Adds review operations and UI scope.
options.risks: Queue design can dominate project effort.
